# Agatha Sowerby

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is a stout woman weighing two hundred pounds whose gait is described as a perpetual waddle. She has heavy, aged arms and aged hands coarsened by labor.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v1 c38 P30](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0030), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001), [v3 c40 P14](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0014)_

## Personality

Mrs. Sowerby is a candid, opinionated, and highly authoritative woman who takes pride in speaking her mind freely without dread or partiality. Though frequently meddlesome, talkative, and critical of others, she possesses a deeply compassionate, kind-hearted, and motherly nature. She is religiously devout and energetic in church and community work, maintaining durable opinions on everything from theology to homemaking. While sharp with people during normal times, she is a forbearing, tireless caregiver during illness.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P45](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0045), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c21 P5](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0005), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)_

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby lived in Sowerby's Hollow in Brierley with her husband Thomas, keeping a vigilant watch over local thoroughfares and leading community and church organizations. After Nell arrived at Grey Shutters, Mrs. Agatha visited and insulted her physical appearance, provoking a passionate outburst from Nell; however, she forgave the child when Nell delivered a full apology. Following Thomas's prolonged illness and death, Mrs. Agatha sold her farm to cover debts and moved into Grey Shutters to reside with her longtime friend Thirza Abernethy. At Grey Shutters, she helped raise Robin and Lucy Farrow, managed domestic duties, and remained active in church affairs.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007), [v3 c13 P55](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0055)_
